scope: 29 topics, 68 descriptions, complete criteria and progression; four format transformations available in the instrument artifact
method: Read complete rubric views by sequential topic blocks and inspected format contracts; checked scientific relations against rendered source. Automated score and parity checks supplement this review.
corrections: Optional visual resources are not compulsory productions
Observed descriptions do not add causal explanation
Investigable questions do not require source research
Frequency scales distinguish frequency from achievement
limits: Defined deterministic patterns, not every possible wording
Visual UI verification is separate and is recorded in the grade report
Curricular personality and motivation statements are not student grading criteria
